text:
The plate is square, about 22-24 cm across, and holds pineapple chunks and watermelon cubes.

I count about 14 pineapple pieces. Each is roughly 2x3x1.5 cm, or about 9 cm³, which comes to about 9 g. That gives about 125 g of pineapple.

I count about 13 watermelon pieces. Each is roughly 2.5 cm on a side, about 15 cm³ or 15 g. That gives about 190 g, but some pieces are smaller, so I'll use about 170 g.

The total is about 295 g, which I'll round to 290 g.

Pineapple is about 0.5 kcal/g, so 125 g gives about 62 kcal. Watermelon is about 0.3 kcal/g, so 170 g gives about 51 kcal. Together that is about 113 kcal, which I'll round to 115.

{"kcal": 115, "mass_g": 290}
